meta.title: 2026–2027 Triathlon Training Plan
meta.rpe: 2-3 very easy, 4 conversational, 5-6 steady, 7 hard repeatable, 8 very hard short only, 9-10 not routine

weeks.objective: Start easy and establish the routine.
weeks.notes: Week 1 is already under way (today is Thursday, Nov 19): start with Thursday’s session, treat Monday–Wednesday as done or skipped, and don’t catch up. Learn the strength movements with light loads.

sessions.title: Rest day — optional mobility
sessions.detail: Rest. Optional 10–15 min mobility routine (MB-1, Part 4).

sessions.title: Easy run + drills (35 min)
sessions.detail: Main: 21 min easy continuous run RPE 4. RPE 3–4.

sessions.title: Strength A (single-leg + calves)
sessions.detail: 20 min main set — Bulgarian split squat 2 × 6–8 per leg; step-ups 2 × 8 per leg; straight-knee calf raises 3 × 10–15; bent-knee calf raises 2 × 10–15; side plank 2 × 30–45 s per side. Learn the movements: bodyweight or very light load, 4+ reps in reserve.

sessions.title: Technique & endurance 1
sessions.detail: 1,500 m. Drills: 4 × 50 m side-kick / 6-1-6 drill (15 s rest); 4 × 50 m fingertip-drag drill (15 s rest) | 4 × 100 m smooth freestyle RPE 4 — count strokes per length (20 s rest) | 4 × 50 m RPE 5, hold the same stroke count (15 s rest). RPE 3–4 (50s at RPE 5).

sessions.title: Cadence + steady aerobic ride
sessions.detail: Main: 6 × 1 min high cadence 100–105 rpm, RPE 4; 2 min easy between; 25 min steady RPE 4–5, 85–95 rpm. RPE 3–5.

sessions.title: OPTIONAL — Optional easy run 15 min
sessions.detail: Straight off the bike, easy RPE 3–4. First session to drop if tired.

sessions.title: Endurance 1
sessions.detail: 1,800 m. 6 × 150 m steady RPE 4–5 (20 s rest); 4 × 50 m kick with a board, RPE 4 (20 s rest); 4 × 50 m build RPE 4 → 6 across each 50 (15 s rest). RPE 4–5.

sessions.title: Strength B (hinge + glutes)
sessions.detail: 20 min main set — Romanian deadlift 2 × 8–10; glute bridge or hip thrust 2 × 10–12; split squat or step-up 2 × 8 per leg; calf raises 2 × 12–15; plank 2 × 30–45 s. Learn the movements: bodyweight or very light load, 4+ reps in reserve.

sessions.title: Aerobic endurance ride — 35 km
sessions.detail: 15 min easy spin RPE 3 → 4; Remainder steady RPE 3–4, 85–95 rpm; every 20 min: 1 min spin-up at 100–105 rpm; Last 10 min easy spin. Fuel: 30–45 g carbohydrate/h + drink to thirst.

sessions.title: Easy brick — 10 min
sessions.detail: 10 min easy run RPE 3–4. First 3 min very short strides, then settle; no pace goals. Straight after the ride.

sessions.title: Long easy run — 8 km
sessions.detail: First 10 min very easy; Continuous easy run RPE 3–4; walk 5 min after. Take water; for runs over 75 min carry 30 g carbohydrate.

SW-T-1.name: Technique & endurance 1
SW-T-1.obj: Learn drills, keep the stroke relaxed, build comfort with sustained smooth swimming.
wu: 300 m easy freestyle, RPE 3, breathe every 3rd stroke
main: 4 × 100 m smooth freestyle RPE 4 — count strokes per length (20 s rest)
4 × 50 m RPE 5, hold the same stroke count (15 s rest)
SW-T-1.cues: Hold the same stroke count on every 100. If it creeps up, slow down.

SW-T-2.name: Technique & endurance 2
SW-T-2.obj: Add catch-up and single-arm drills; extend the smooth main set.
main: 6 × 100 m smooth freestyle RPE 4 (20 s rest)
4 × 50 m single-arm drill (alternate arms each length) (15 s rest)
SW-T-2.cues: Pause briefly at full extension in catch-up. In single-arm keep the resting arm long, hips level.

SW-T-3.name: Technique cutback
SW-T-3.obj: Shorter technique-only session for recovery weeks.
main: 4 × 100 m smooth freestyle RPE 4 (20 s rest)
cd: 300 m easy, mix freestyle and backstroke
SW-T-3.cues: Finish feeling fresh — you should not be tired.

SW-T-4.name: Technique & endurance 3
SW-T-4.obj: Three drill sets then longer smooth swims with bilateral breathing.
main: 6 × 100 m smooth freestyle RPE 4–5 (20 s rest)
4 × 50 m breathing every 3rd stroke (bilateral), RPE 4–5 (15 s rest)
SW-T-4.cues: Bilateral breathing balances the stroke and prepares you for open-water sighting.

SW-T-5.name: Technique & endurance 4 (sculling)
SW-T-5.obj: Add sculling for ‘feel’ and longer repeats.
main: 3 × 200 m smooth freestyle RPE 4–5 (30 s rest)
4 × 50 m strong form RPE 6 (20 s rest)
SW-T-5.cues: Strong 50s: lengthen the stroke first, then increase rate slightly. No thrashing.
drills: 4 × 50 m front sculling 25 m + swim 25 m (15 s rest)

SW-T-6.name: Technique & endurance 5 (sighting)
main: 3 × 300 m smooth freestyle RPE 4–5 (30 s rest)
4 × 50 m sighting practice: look forward every 6th stroke (15 s rest)
SW-T-6.cues: Sight with eyes only — the head should barely rise.

SW-T-7.name: Technique cutback 2
SW-T-7.obj: Shorter technique + moderate swim for cutback weeks.
main: 4 × 100 m smooth freestyle RPE 4 (20 s rest)
4 × 50 m RPE 5 (15 s rest)

SW-T-8.name: Technique & endurance 6
SW-T-8.obj: Longer repeats with sighting and strong form at the end.
main: 2 × 400 m smooth freestyle RPE 4–5 (40 s rest)
4 × 50 m sighting practice (15 s rest)
4 × 50 m strong form RPE 6 (20 s rest)
SW-T-8.cues: On the 400s, negative-split: second 200 slightly faster than the first.
drills: 4 × 50 m front sculling 25 m + swim 25 m (15 s rest)

SW-T-9.name: Technique & endurance 7
main: 3 × 400 m smooth freestyle RPE 5 (40 s rest)
4 × 50 m sighting practice (15 s rest)
SW-T-9.cues: Watch for form breakdown in the third 400 — slow down rather than let the stroke fall apart.

SW-T-10.name: Technique & speed skills
SW-T-10.obj: Smooth swimming plus short fast 25s (sprint skills).
main: 6 × 100 m smooth freestyle RPE 5 (15 s rest)
4 × 50 m sighting practice (15 s rest)
8 × 25 m fast but relaxed RPE 7 (30 s rest)
SW-T-10.cues: Fast 25s: long, relaxed strokes with a stronger kick — not flailing.
drills: 4 × 50 m front sculling 25 m + swim 25 m (15 s rest)

SW-T-11.name: Olympic technique & endurance
main: 3 × 300 m RPE 5 (30 s rest)
4 × 100 m RPE 6 (steady, strong) (20 s rest)
SW-T-11.cues: Settle into a rhythm you could hold for 1,500 m.

SW-T-12.name: Olympic continuous swim
SW-T-12.obj: Practise a continuous race-effort swim with sighting.
main: 600 m continuous RPE 5 with sighting every 8–10 strokes
4 × 100 m RPE 6 (20 s rest)
4 × 50 m RPE 7 (20 s rest)
SW-T-12.cues: Count lengths to stay oriented. Keep the same tempo for the entire 600 m.

SW-E-1.name: Endurance 1
main: 6 × 150 m steady RPE 4–5 (20 s rest)
4 × 50 m kick with a board, RPE 4 (20 s rest)
4 × 50 m build RPE 4 → 6 across each 50 (15 s rest)
SW-E-1.cues: Keep the 150s the same speed. Kick from the hips, not the knees.

4 × 200 m RPE 5 (30 s rest)
4 × 50 m strong form RPE 6 (20 s rest)
SW-E-6.cues: If you need to stop, stop at a wall for 10 s and restart — don’t grind through bad form.

SW-E-7.name: Endurance 6
main: 4 × 300 m steady RPE 5 (30 s rest)
6 × 100 m RPE 5–6 (20 s rest)
4 × 50 m kick with a board RPE 4 (20 s rest)
SW-E-7.cues: Hold the pace on all four 300s.

SW-E-8.name: Endurance 7
main: 1,500 m continuous steady RPE 4–5 (60 lengths)
6 × 100 m RPE 5–6 (20 s rest)
4 × 50 m strong form RPE 6 (20 s rest)
SW-E-8.cues: A confidence builder: 1,500 m non-stop is the Olympic swim distance.

SW-E-9.name: Endurance 8 (build)
main: 2 × 600 m RPE 5 (45 s rest)
4 × 100 m RPE 6 (20 s rest)
4 × 50 m RPE 7 (30 s rest)
4 × 50 m kick with a board RPE 4 (20 s rest)
SW-E-9.cues: Don’t treat the 50s as a sprint — controlled fast.

SW-E-10.name: Endurance 9 (build)
main: 3 × 500 m RPE 5–6 (40 s rest)
6 × 100 m RPE 6 (20 s rest)
4 × 50 m RPE 7 (30 s rest)
SW-E-10.cues: Hold form when tired; shorten the rest only if the stroke stays good.

SW-E-11.name: Olympic endurance 1
SW-E-11.obj: Olympic-distance endurance with a 1,000 m race-effort swim.
wu: 400 m easy freestyle RPE 3, with 4 × 50 build
main: 1,000 m steady RPE 5 with sighting every 8–10 strokes
4 × 100 m RPE 6 (20 s rest)
4 × 50 m RPE 7 (30 s rest)
4 × 50 m kick with a board RPE 4 (20 s rest)
SW-E-11.cues: Settle into a rhythm early and keep it.

SW-E-12.name: Olympic endurance 2
wu: 400 m easy freestyle RPE 3, with 4 × 50 build
main: 1,500 m continuous RPE 5 with sighting every 8–10 strokes
6 × 100 m RPE 6 (20 s rest)
SW-E-12.cues: Rehearse the Olympic swim distance; negative-split the last 500 m.

SW-E-13.name: 70.3 endurance
SW-E-13.obj: 1,900 m continuous swim — the half-iron distance — at a controlled effort.
wu: 400 m easy freestyle RPE 3, with 4 × 50 build
main: 1,900 m continuous RPE 5 (76 lengths), sighting every 8–10 strokes
4 × 50 m strong form RPE 6 (20 s rest)
SW-E-13.cues: This is your race rehearsal swim — practise settling in and breathing bilaterally.

SW-E-14.name: Taper endurance
SW-E-14.obj: Maintain swim feel while reducing volume.
main: 800 m continuous RPE 5
6 × 100 m RPE 6 (20 s rest)
4 × 50 m RPE 7 (30 s rest)
SW-E-14.cues: Finish energized. You should feel you could do more.

SW-R-1.name: Sprint race pace 1
SW-R-1.obj: Rehearse the 750 m sprint swim effort in 150 m chunks.
wu: 400 m easy freestyle RPE 3, with 4 × 50 build
main: 5 × 150 m race effort RPE 6–7 (30 s rest)
200 m easy
8 × 25 m fast RPE 8, controlled (30 s rest)
SW-R-1.cues: Practise a controlled start: first 25 m smooth.

SW-R-2.name: Sprint race pace 2
SW-R-2.obj: Swim a continuous 750 m at sprint race effort.
wu: 400 m easy freestyle RPE 3, with 4 × 50 build
main: 750 m continuous RPE 6–7 (30 lengths) with sighting every 8–10 strokes
200 m easy
6 × 50 m RPE 7 (20 s rest)
4 × 50 m kick with a board RPE 4 (20 s rest)
SW-R-2.cues: A fitness test: note your time for the 750 m and your RPE.

SW-R-3.name: Sprint sharpen
SW-R-3.obj: Light race-pace swim for the week before the sprint.
main: 3 × 150 m RPE 6–7 (30 s rest)
4 × 50 m RPE 7–8 (30 s rest)

SW-R-4.name: 70.3 taper swim
main: 3 × 200 m RPE 5–6 (30 s rest)
4 × 50 m RPE 7 (30 s rest)

SW-OW-1.name: Open water 1 — acclimatize & sight
SW-OW-1.obj: Get comfortable in open water, practise sighting and a straight line.
wu: 5 min easy swim along the shore, RPE 3
main: 4 × 5 min steady swim RPE 4–5 with sighting every 8–10 strokes (swim a loop between two landmarks); 1 min easy between
SW-OW-1.cues: Choose a fixed landmark; look up with eyes only; relax your shoulders.

SW-OW-2.name: Open water 2 — continuous & start
SW-OW-2.obj: Practise a start, continuous swimming and a turn around a marker.
wu: 3 × 30 s start practice: 6–8 hard strokes then settle; 1 min easy between
main: 3 × 10 min continuous RPE 5 with sighting every 8–10 strokes; 2 min easy between
SW-OW-2.cues: Find clear water; avoid contact until you’re confident.

SW-OW-3.name: Open water 3 — race simulation
SW-OW-3.obj: Rehearse the race: wetsuit, start, sustained swim, exit and run to transition.
wu: 10 min easy swim with 4 × 1 min build
main: 2 × 15 min RPE 5 with sighting every 8–10 strokes; first 60 s at RPE 7; 3 min easy between
cd: 5 min easy swim, exit and jog to your transition
SW-OW-3.cues: Use race-day goggles and (if allowed) wetsuit; practise exiting with the wetsuit zipper cord.

RN-Q-1.name: Easy run + drills (30 min)
wu: 5 min very easy jog / brisk walk, RPE 2–3
4 min drills: A-march, ankling, leg swings, butt-kicks (2 × 20 m each, walk back)
main: 16 min easy continuous run RPE 4
cd: 5 min easy walk/jog and calf stretch

RN-Q-2.name: Easy run + drills (35 min)
RN-Q-2.obj: Slightly longer aerobic run and technique.
wu: 5 min very easy jog / brisk walk, RPE 2–3
4 min drills: A-march, ankling, leg swings, butt-kicks (2 × 20 m each, walk back)
main: 21 min easy continuous run RPE 4
cd: 5 min easy walk/jog and calf stretch

RN-Q-3.name: Easy run + drills (40 min)
RN-Q-3.obj: Build run durability with time on feet.
wu: 5 min very easy jog / brisk walk, RPE 2–3
4 min drills: A-march, ankling, leg swings, butt-kicks (2 × 20 m each, walk back)
main: 26 min easy continuous run RPE 4
cd: 5 min easy walk/jog and calf stretch
RN-Q-3.cues: If calves or shins feel tight, shorten the run to 30 min.

RN-Q-4.name: Easy run + 4 strides
wu: 3 min drills: A-march, ankling, leg swings, butt-kicks (2 × 20 m each, walk back)
main: 20 min easy continuous run RPE 4
4 × 20 s relaxed strides to RPE 6, walk/jog 60 s between; 1 min easy between
RN-Q-4.cues: Strides are about smoothness, not speed.

RN-Q-5.name: Easy run + 6 strides
RN-Q-5.obj: Easy aerobic run with stride work.
wu: 3 min drills: A-march, ankling, leg swings, butt-kicks (2 × 20 m each, walk back)
main: 20 min easy continuous run RPE 4
6 × 20 s relaxed strides to RPE 6, walk/jog 60 s between; 1 min easy between
RN-Q-5.cues: Stay tall; swing the arms back, not across the body.

RN-Q-6.name: Steady-state intervals 3 × 5 min
wu: 10 min easy jog RPE 3–4, including 3 short strides
main: 3 × 5 min steady RPE 5; 2 min easy between
RN-Q-6.cues: Comfortably steady — you can speak in short sentences.

RN-Q-7.name: Steady-state intervals 4 × 5 min
wu: 10 min easy jog RPE 3–4, including 3 short strides
main: 4 × 5 min steady RPE 5; 2 min easy between
RN-Q-7.cues: Keep pace even across all four.

RN-Q-8.name: Tempo 3 × 6 min
RN-Q-8.obj: Controlled tempo (RPE 6) — introduces comfortably hard running.
wu: 12 min easy jog RPE 3–4 with drills and 3 strides
main: 3 × 6 min controlled tempo RPE 6; 2 min easy between
RN-Q-8.cues: RPE 6 should still feel controlled; stop at 2 reps if form falls apart.

RN-Q-9.name: Tempo 3 × 8 min
wu: 12 min easy jog RPE 3–4 with drills and 3 strides
main: 3 × 8 min controlled tempo RPE 6; 2 min easy between
RN-Q-9.cues: Smooth and even; no sprinting at the end of reps.

RN-Q-10.name: Tempo 2 × 12 min
wu: 12 min easy jog RPE 3–4 with drills and 3 strides
main: 2 × 12 min controlled tempo RPE 6; 3 min easy between
RN-Q-10.cues: Practise the rhythm you’d hold for 10 km.

RN-Q-11.name: Sprint intervals 4 × 3 min
RN-Q-11.obj: Short controlled hard running for sprint-race pace.
wu: 4 × 20 s strides RPE 6; 1 min easy between
main: 4 × 3 min hard but repeatable RPE 7; 2 min easy between
RN-Q-11.cues: Not all-out: you should finish the last rep controlled.

RN-Q-12.name: Sprint intervals 5 × 3 min
wu: 4 × 20 s strides RPE 6; 1 min easy between
main: 5 × 3 min hard but repeatable RPE 7; 2 min easy between

RN-Q-13.name: Sprint sharpen 3 × 3 min
wu: 4 × 20 s strides RPE 6; 1 min easy between
main: 3 × 3 min RPE 7; 2 min easy between
RN-Q-13.cues: Stay smooth; you should feel energized.

RN-Q-14.name: Steady 3 × 10 min (70.3 run feel)
RN-Q-14.obj: Practise sustained steady running at 70.3 effort.
wu: 10 min easy jog RPE 3–4 with 3 strides
main: 3 × 10 min steady RPE 5; 2 min easy between
RN-Q-14.cues: Relaxed, tall posture; settle into a rhythm.

RN-Q-15.name: Taper steady 2 × 10 min + strides
wu: 10 min easy jog RPE 3–4 with 3 strides
main: 2 × 10 min steady RPE 5–6; 2 min easy between
4 × 20 s relaxed strides; 1 min easy between

RN-Q-16.name: Taper rhythm 2 × 3 min + strides
wu: 10 min easy jog RPE 3–4 with 3 strides
main: 2 × 3 min race effort RPE 5–6; 3 min easy between
4 × 20 s relaxed strides; 1 min easy between

RN-O-1.name: Optional easy run 10 min
RN-O-1.obj: Practise running off the bike; add a little weekly run frequency.
main: 10 min easy run RPE 3–4 straight after the bike

RN-O-2.name: Optional easy run 15 min
RN-O-2.obj: Practise running off the bike; add a little weekly run frequency.
main: 15 min easy run RPE 3–4 straight after the bike
RN-O-2.cues: Short, quiet steps. Cut to 10 minutes if tired.

BK-Q-1.name: Cadence + steady aerobic ride
main: 6 × 1 min high cadence 100–105 rpm, RPE 4; 2 min easy between
25 min steady RPE 4–5, 85–95 rpm
BK-Q-1.cues: Upper body quiet; pedal in circles.

BK-Q-2.name: Easy cadence ride (cutback)
main: 4 × 1 min high cadence 100–105 rpm, RPE 4; 2 min easy between
10 min steady RPE 4

BK-Q-3.name: Steady intervals + cadence bursts
BK-Q-3.obj: Introduce RPE 5 intervals and high-cadence bursts.
main: 3 × 8 min RPE 5, 90 rpm; 3 min easy between
5 × 30 s high cadence 100–110 rpm; 1 min 30 s easy between

BK-Q-4.name: Tempo introduction 2 × 10
main: 2 × 10 min RPE 5–6 tempo, 85–90 rpm; 5 min easy between
5 × 30 s high cadence 100–110 rpm; 1 min 30 s easy between
BK-Q-4.cues: Settle into the tempo gradually; don’t surge.

BK-Q-5.name: Tempo 3 × 8
main: 3 × 8 min RPE 5–6 tempo, 85–90 rpm; 4 min easy between
5 × 30 s high cadence 100–110 rpm; 1 min 30 s easy between
BK-Q-5.cues: Same power on the third rep as the first.

BK-Q-6.name: Tempo 3 × 10
wu: 15 min easy spin RPE 3 → 4, including 3 × 30 s spin-ups
main: 3 × 10 min RPE 6 tempo, 85–90 rpm; 5 min easy between
BK-Q-6.cues: If RPE creeps up, reduce effort slightly.

BK-Q-7.name: Tempo 4 × 8
wu: 15 min easy spin RPE 3 → 4, including 3 × 30 s spin-ups
main: 4 × 8 min RPE 6 tempo, 85–90 rpm; 4 min easy between

BK-Q-8.name: Threshold 3 × 8 + cadence
main: 3 × 8 min RPE 6–7, 85–90 rpm; 4 min easy between
5 × 30 s high cadence 100–110 rpm; 1 min 30 s easy between

BK-Q-9.name: Threshold 4 × 8
main: 4 × 8 min RPE 6–7, 85–90 rpm; 4 min easy between
BK-Q-9.cues: Don’t go out too hard — last rep equals the first.

BK-Q-10.name: Threshold 3 × 10
main: 3 × 10 min RPE 7, 85–90 rpm; 5 min easy between
BK-Q-10.cues: RPE 7 = hard but repeatable. Stop early if form breaks down.

BK-Q-11.name: Sprint intervals 5 × 5
wu: 15 min easy spin RPE 3 → 4, including 3 × 30 s spin-ups
main: 5 × 5 min RPE 7, 90 rpm; 3 min easy between

BK-Q-12.name: Resistance climbs 6 × 3 + cadence
main: 6 × 3 min seated climb or big gear, 60–70 rpm, RPE 7; 3 min easy between
5 × 30 s high cadence 100–110 rpm; 1 min 30 s easy between
BK-Q-12.cues: Back flat, hands light, don’t pull on the bars.

BK-Q-13.name: Sprint threshold 4 × 6 + 3 × 1
BK-Q-13.obj: Race-effort threshold work and short surges.
main: 4 × 6 min RPE 7, 90 rpm; 3 min easy between
3 × 1 min RPE 8 surges; 2 min easy between
BK-Q-13.cues: Surges are short; return to easy quickly.

BK-Q-14.name: Sprint sharpen 3 × 4
main: 3 × 4 min RPE 7, 90 rpm; 3 min easy between
4 × 30 s high cadence 100–110 rpm; 1 min 30 s easy between

BK-Q-15.name: Olympic tempo 3 × 12
wu: 15 min easy spin RPE 3 → 4, including 3 × 30 s spin-ups
main: 3 × 12 min RPE 6, 85–90 rpm; 4 min easy between
BK-Q-15.cues: Practise your race position and fuelling.

BK-Q-16.name: Olympic tempo 2 × 20
wu: 15 min easy spin RPE 3 → 4, including 3 × 30 s spin-ups
main: 2 × 20 min RPE 6, 85–90 rpm; 5 min easy between
BK-Q-16.cues: Aim for the same RPE in both blocks.

BK-Q-17.name: Olympic sharpen 2 × 12
wu: 15 min easy spin RPE 3 → 4, including 3 × 30 s spin-ups
main: 2 × 12 min RPE 6–7, 85–90 rpm; 5 min easy between
3 × 30 s high cadence 100–110 rpm; 1 min 30 s easy between

BK-Q-18.name: 70.3 effort 2 × 20
wu: 15 min easy spin RPE 3 → 4, including 3 × 30 s spin-ups
main: 2 × 20 min RPE 5–6, 85–90 rpm (take a carb drink/snack in each block); 5 min easy between
BK-Q-18.cues: Settle early and fuel like it’s race day.

BK-Q-19.name: 70.3 effort 2 × 15
main: 2 × 15 min RPE 5–6, 85–90 rpm; 5 min easy between
BK-Q-19.cues: Keep it controlled — big weekend ahead.

BK-Q-20.name: Taper 2 × 10 + cadence
main: 2 × 10 min RPE 5–6, 85–90 rpm; 5 min easy between
4 × 30 s high cadence 100–110 rpm; 1 min 30 s easy between

BK-Q-21.name: Taper 3 × 5
main: 3 × 5 min RPE 5–6, 85–90 rpm; 3 min easy between

BL-1.name: Aerobic endurance ride
main: Remainder steady RPE 3–4, 85–95 rpm; every 20 min: 1 min spin-up at 100–105 rpm
BL-1.cues: Keep conversation easy; eat and drink on schedule.

BL-2.name: Long ride with 2 × 10 min blocks @ RPE 5
BL-2.obj: Build aerobic endurance and sustained controlled power.
main: Ride RPE 3–4 until ~40–60 min in. Then 2 × 10 min @ RPE 5, 85–90 rpm, with 5 min easy between blocks. Remainder RPE 3–4.
BL-2.cues: Use the same effort in each block. Eat before and after each block.

BL-3.name: Long ride with 2 × 12 min blocks @ RPE 5–6
BL-3.obj: Build aerobic endurance and sustained controlled power.
main: Ride RPE 3–4 until ~40–60 min in. Then 2 × 12 min @ RPE 5–6, 85–90 rpm, with 5 min easy between blocks. Remainder RPE 3–4.
BL-3.cues: Use the same effort in each block. Eat before and after each block.

BL-4.name: Long ride with 2 × 15 min blocks @ RPE 5–6
BL-4.obj: Build aerobic endurance and sustained controlled power.
main: Ride RPE 3–4 until ~40–60 min in. Then 2 × 15 min @ RPE 5–6, 85–90 rpm, with 5 min easy between blocks. Remainder RPE 3–4.
BL-4.cues: Use the same effort in each block. Eat before and after each block.

BL-5.name: Long ride with 3 × 10 min blocks @ RPE 5–6
BL-5.obj: Build aerobic endurance and sustained controlled power.
main: Ride RPE 3–4 until ~40–60 min in. Then 3 × 10 min @ RPE 5–6, 85–90 rpm, with 5 min easy between blocks. Remainder RPE 3–4.
BL-5.cues: Use the same effort in each block. Eat before and after each block.

BL-6.name: Long ride with 2 × 15 min blocks @ RPE 6
BL-6.obj: Build aerobic endurance and sustained controlled power.
main: Ride RPE 3–4 until ~40–60 min in. Then 2 × 15 min @ RPE 6, 85–90 rpm, with 5 min easy between blocks. Remainder RPE 3–4.
BL-6.cues: Use the same effort in each block. Eat before and after each block.

BL-7.name: Long ride with 2 × 20 min blocks @ RPE 6
BL-7.obj: Build aerobic endurance and sustained controlled power.
main: Ride RPE 3–4 until ~40–60 min in. Then 2 × 20 min @ RPE 6, 85–90 rpm, with 5 min easy between blocks. Remainder RPE 3–4.
BL-7.cues: Use the same effort in each block. Eat before and after each block.

BL-8.name: Long ride with 1 × 35 min Olympic effort
BL-8.obj: Practise Olympic-distance bike effort and fuelling, followed by a brick run.
main: Ride RPE 3–4 until ~30 min in. Then 1 × 35 min @ RPE 6 (Olympic race effort), 85–90 rpm, with race nutrition. Remainder RPE 3–4.
BL-8.cues: Rehearse race nutrition and your aerobar/race position.

BL-9.name: Long ride with 2 × 20 min blocks @ RPE 5
BL-9.obj: Build aerobic endurance and sustained controlled power.
main: Ride RPE 3–4 until ~40–60 min in. Then 2 × 20 min @ RPE 5, 85–90 rpm, with 5 min easy between blocks. Remainder RPE 3–4.
BL-9.cues: Use the same effort in each block. Eat before and after each block.

BL-10.name: Long ride with 2 × 30 min blocks @ RPE 5
BL-10.obj: Build aerobic endurance and sustained controlled power.
main: Ride RPE 3–4 until ~40–60 min in. Then 2 × 30 min @ RPE 5, 85–90 rpm, with 5 min easy between blocks. Remainder RPE 3–4.
BL-10.cues: Use the same effort in each block. Eat before and after each block.

BL-11.name: Long ride with 1 × 60 min 70.3 effort
main: Ride RPE 3–4 until ~30 min in. Then 1 × 60 min @ RPE 5 (70.3 race effort — comfortably hard, short phrases only), 85–90 rpm, with race nutrition every 15–20 min. Remainder RPE 3–4.
BL-11.cues: Resist the urge to go harder on rolling terrain. Aim for steady effort.

BL-12.name: Long ride with 2 × 15 min blocks @ RPE 5
BL-12.obj: Build aerobic endurance and sustained controlled power.
main: Ride RPE 3–4 until ~40–60 min in. Then 2 × 15 min @ RPE 5, 85–90 rpm, with 5 min easy between blocks. Remainder RPE 3–4.
BL-12.cues: Use the same effort in each block. Eat before and after each block.

BL-13.name: 70.3 dress-rehearsal ride
BL-13.obj: Full-distance race rehearsal: pacing, fuelling, hydration, aero position.
wu: First 10 km easy at RPE 3–4 (as in race), settle in
main: Then steady RPE 5 (70.3 race effort), cadence 85–90 rpm, without surges on hills (RPE 6 max).
Fuel and drink by the clock exactly as planned for race day (60–75 g carbohydrate/hour + sodium).
cd: Last 10 min easy spin to prepare for the run
BL-13.cues: Wear race kit, use race wheels/shoes if possible. Practise taking bottles and eating while aero.

BR-1.name: Easy brick
BR-1.obj: Adaptation to running off the bike.
main: {N} min easy run RPE 3–4. First 3 min very short strides, then settle; no pace goals.

BR-2.name: Controlled brick
BR-2.obj: Practise a steady run off the bike.
main: {N} min total: first 5 min RPE 3–4, then {M} min @ RPE 5 (steady, controlled), last 5 min RPE 4.

BR-3.name: Sprint-pace brick
BR-3.obj: Practise transition speed and sprint-race run effort.
main: Practise T2 (helmet off, shoes on) then {N} min: first 3 min RPE 5, then RPE 6–7 (sprint 5 km feel), last 3 min easy.

BR-4.name: Olympic-pace brick
BR-4.obj: Practise Olympic-distance run effort off the bike.
main: {N} min total: first 5 min RPE 4, then {M} min @ RPE 5–6 (Olympic run effort), last 3 min RPE 4.

BR-5.name: 70.3-pace brick
BR-5.obj: Practise settling into 70.3 run effort off the bike.
main: {N} min total: first 5 min RPE 3–4 (settle), then {M} min @ RPE 4–5 (70.3 run effort), last 3 min RPE 3–4.
BR-5.cues: Patience: the first 10 minutes are the most important.

RL-1.name: Long easy run
main: Continuous easy run RPE 3–4

RL-2.name: Long easy run with walk breaks
RL-2.obj: Build durability while limiting tissue stress.
main: Run RPE 3–4 with a 1 min walk break every 15 min (or as soon as form drops)
RL-2.cues: Walk breaks are a tool, not a failure.

ST-A.name: Strength A (single-leg + calves)
ST-A.obj: Leg strength, balance, calf and trunk durability.
wu: 5 min warm-up: easy bike or brisk walk, leg swings, bodyweight squats
main: 20 min main set — Bulgarian split squat 2 × 6–8 per leg; step-ups 2 × 8 per leg; straight-knee calf raises 3 × 10–15; bent-knee calf raises 2 × 10–15; side plank 2 × 30–45 s per side
cd: 5 min easy hip-flexor and calf stretches
ST-A.cues: Control the lowering (2–3 s), push through the whole foot.

ST-B.name: Strength B (hinge + glutes)
ST-B.obj: Posterior chain, glute and trunk strength.
wu: 5 min warm-up: easy bike or brisk walk, leg swings, bodyweight hip hinges
main: 20 min main set — Romanian deadlift 2 × 8–10; glute bridge or hip thrust 2 × 10–12; split squat or step-up 2 × 8 per leg; calf raises 2 × 12–15; plank 2 × 30–45 s
cd: 5 min easy hamstring and hip stretches
ST-B.cues: Flat back, hinge at the hips, squeeze glutes at the top.

ST-As.name: Strength A short
ST-As.obj: Shorter single-leg + calf session for race-specific phases.
wu: 3 min warm-up: leg swings, bodyweight squats
main: 15 min main set — Bulgarian split squat 2 × 6 per leg; straight-knee calf raises 3 × 12; bent-knee calf raises 1 × 12; side plank 2 × 30 s per side

ST-Bs.name: Strength B short
ST-Bs.obj: Shorter hinge session for race-specific phases.
wu: 3 min warm-up: leg swings, hip hinges
main: 15 min main set — Romanian deadlift 2 × 8; hip thrust 2 × 10; calf raises 2 × 12; plank 2 × 30 s

ST-M.name: Strength maintenance (single session)
ST-M.obj: One session that covers the key movements.
wu: 3 min warm-up: leg swings, bodyweight squats
main: 20 min main set — Bulgarian split squat 2 × 6 per leg; Romanian deadlift 2 × 8; straight-knee calf raises 2 × 12; bent-knee calf raises 1 × 12; side plank 2 × 30 s per side
cd: 2 min easy calf and hip stretch
ST-M.cues: Keep loads moderate; this is maintenance.

ST-L.name: Strength light (taper)
main: 8 min main set — bodyweight split squat 1 × 8 per leg; glute bridge 1 × 12; calf raises 1 × 15; plank 1 × 30 s
ST-L.cues: Should feel like activation, not training.

MB-1.name: Mobility routine
MB-1.obj: Restore range of motion; promote recovery.
main: 12 min routine — hip flexor stretch 2 × 30 s per side; figure-4 glute stretch 2 × 30 s per side; wall calf stretch (straight + bent knee) 2 × 30 s per side; thoracic rotation 8 per side; cat–cow 8; 90/90 hip rotations 6 per side; optional foam-roll calves, quads, glutes 1 min each
MB-1.cues: Breathe slowly; never stretch into sharp pain.

RW-1.name: Sprint week run sharpener
main: 3 × 2 min sprint race pace RPE 6–7; 2 min easy between
4 × 20 s relaxed strides; 1 min easy between

RW-2.name: Sprint week swim
main: 3 × 100 m RPE 6–7 (30 s rest)
4 × 50 m RPE 7–8 (30 s rest)

RW-3.name: Sprint week bike
main: 3 × 3 min sprint race effort RPE 7; 3 min easy between
3 × 30 s high cadence 100–110 rpm; 1 min 30 s easy between

RW-4.name: Race-eve shake-out (bike + run)
RW-4.obj: Wake up the legs and check equipment.
wu: 20 min easy spin RPE 3 with 3 × 20 s pick-ups at race cadence
main: 8 min easy jog RPE 3–4 with 3 × 15 s relaxed strides
RW-4.cues: Check bike gears, brakes and tyre pressure.

RW-5.name: Post-race recovery
main: 30 min very easy spin or walk RPE 2; optional 20 min easy swim
RW-5.cues: Eat, hydrate and go for a relaxed walk.

RW-6.name: Olympic week run sharpener
RW-6.obj: Maintain sharpness before the Olympic race.
main: 3 × 3 min Olympic race effort RPE 6; 2 min easy between
4 × 20 s relaxed strides; 1 min easy between

RW-7.name: Olympic week swim
main: 3 × 200 m RPE 5–6 (30 s rest)
4 × 50 m RPE 7 (30 s rest)

RW-8.name: Olympic week bike
main: 2 × 6 min Olympic effort RPE 6; 4 min easy between
3 × 30 s high cadence 100–110 rpm; 1 min 30 s easy between

RW-9.name: Olympic week short swim
RW-9.obj: Keep the feel of the water.
main: 4 × 25 m RPE 7, relaxed (30 s rest)
200 m easy

RW-10.name: 70.3 week run sharpener
main: 2 × 3 min 70.3 run effort RPE 5; 3 min easy between
4 × 20 s relaxed strides; 1 min easy between

RW-11.name: 70.3 week swim
RW-11.obj: Light, smooth swim with race-pace touches.
main: 3 × 200 m RPE 5 (30 s rest)
4 × 50 m RPE 6 (30 s rest)

RW-12.name: 70.3 week bike
main: 3 × 3 min 70.3 race effort RPE 5; 3 min easy between
3 × 30 s high cadence 100–110 rpm; 1 min 30 s easy between

RW-13.name: 70.3 race-eve shake-out
RW-13.obj: Keep the legs loose; check equipment.
wu: 20 min easy spin RPE 3 with 3 × 20 s pick-ups at race cadence
main: 8 min easy jog RPE 3–4 with 3 × 15 s relaxed strides
10 min easy swim (open water if possible) RPE 3
